blurb: Guests can take a behind-the-scenes tour on Saturdays to learn about the company history and brewing process while tasting their beers. The brewery was started by two brothers in 2001 and produces craft beers using recycled materials. They also sell merchandise and coffee beans online.
hoursText: Call 10 am to 4 pm to reserve Saturday tours
